base_dir.description: Base directory for configuration, state, and runtime files (must be writable).

syslog.description: Send log messages to the system syslog facility.

interface.description: Network interface name to bind services to (empty = listen on all interfaces).

http_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP control and status interface.

http_host.description: Hostname or IP to bind the HTTP server to (empty = all interfaces).

enable_https.description: Enable secure HTTPS access to the control interface.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (required if HTTPS enabled).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (required if HTTPS enabled).

input_enabled.description: Enable receiving MIDI from hardware input ports (e.g., USB-MIDI adapters).

output_enabled.description: Enable sending MIDI to hardware output ports.

default_clock_source.description: Source for MIDI timing: internal (software-generated) or external (from MIDI input).

ports.description: List of MIDI ports to expose (each defined as an input/output name or ALSA port).

name.description: Name of the MIDI port (e.g., 'hw:1,0,0' for ALSA, or user-defined alias).

ws_port.description: TCP port for the real-time WebSocket MIDI bridge.

enable_cors.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing for WebSocket connections.

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origin hostnames/domains for WebSocket connections.

server.description: NTP server hostname or IP address to use for time synchronization.

enabled.description: Enable NTP-based time synchronization (required for accurate MIDI timing).

broker.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP address.

port.description: MQTT broker port (typically 1883 for unencrypted, 8883 for TLS).

enabled.description: Enable MIDI bridging to/from MQTT (publishes/subscribes to topics under topic_base).

client_id.description: Unique MQTT client ID (leave blank to auto-generate).

topic_base.description: Base topic for MIDI messages (e.g., 'dsmidi/output' sends MIDI from device).

qos.description: MQTT Quality of Service level: 0 (at most once), 1 (at least once), 2 (exactly once).

retained.description: Mark published MQTT messages as retained (new subscribers get last message immediately).

enabled.description: Enable the built-in web-based configuration and monitoring UI.

theme.description: Color theme for the web UI.
